title: Hawkish Fed Repricing, Middle East Oil Risks, and RBI Liquidity Escalation
changed: US rate expectations repriced higher across the week following hawkish Fed comments and strong US jobs data, driving the 10-year US Treasury yield to 4.79%. Term premia widened across G7 debt markets, with UK long-term borrowing costs reaching 1998 highs, even as a widening US trade deficit of $88.6 billion points to a drag on Q3 US GDP. For your portfolio, this re-anchors dollar strength, narrows the yield differential with Indian sovereign paper, and maintains pressure on foreign portfolio flows.

Energy risks escalated after US military strikes on Iranian island targets pushed Brent crude near $89 per barrel. While a 23% surge in H1 2026 US LNG exports and progress on Venezuelan crude supply provide structural supply caps, immediate refined fuel price increases threaten to expand India's import bill and current account deficit, tempering the buffer provided by July's services trade surplus.

In India, macro signals diverged as manufacturing PMI fell to a five-year low while food, protein, and sugar price pressures remained sticky. The RBI responded to money market conditions by escalating liquidity absorption with a ₹7 lakh crore 30-day VRRR auction. This followed the central bank's full rejection of bids in a ₹30,000 crore government bond buyback, signaling direct resistance to primary dealer demands for higher sovereign yields.

Capital markets face an upcoming liquidity absorption test following SEBI's approval of the ₹30,000 crore NSE IPO. On the tax and regulatory front, the GST Council prioritized procedural compliance ease over rate restructuring, while the RBI issued updated operational rules for non-resident bank accounts at AD Category-I banks and standardized portfolio valuation guidelines for Urban Co-operative Banks.

In corporate sectors, Volkswagen formalized 50,000 job cuts amidst European manufacturing contraction, while Nvidia acquired Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, expanding the AI capex cycle into software infrastructure despite central bank warnings on technology capital expenditure risks.

threads.name: US 10-year Treasury yield momentum
threads.note: Resilient US labor data and G7 fiscal borrowing needs pushed the 10-year yield to 4.79%. Weakening US employment figures or softer inflation metrics are needed to break this upward yield trajectory.

threads.name: RBI money market liquidity management
threads.note: The central bank shifted to a ₹7 lakh crore 30-day VRRR auction while rejecting higher yield bids in government buybacks. Sustained liquidity draining keeps short-term T-bill yields anchored above 5.25%.

threads.name: Brent crude oil and current account pressure
threads.note: Military strikes on Iranian island targets drove Brent crude toward $89. Price drops back toward lower range bounds require de-escalation in Middle East geopolitical tensions or expanded non-OPEC output.

threads.name: AI capex expansion
threads.note: Nvidia's $12.9 billion Hugging Face deal extends technology capex from hardware into developer software. Broader corporate margin compression or central bank warnings on capital expenditure volatility could break momentum.
